CaseContext.description:
Explicit routing metadata.

Every field here is an input to authority routing. Blueprint §10.2: the system may not infer
service type, person status, or position sensitivity from document content when explicit
metadata is required. Fields that routing needs but that may be genuinely unknown are
optional here and produce a *blocking information gap* at routing time rather than a guess.

position_risk_level.description: Required to route suitability/fitness. Absence is a blocking gap, not a default.

position_sensitivity.description: Required to route national-security eligibility. Absence is a blocking gap.

conditional_offer_date.description: Fair Chance Act process control (blueprint §2.5): criminal-history inquiry timing is evaluated relative to this date.
conditional_offer_date.title: Conditional Offer Date

CaseContext.title: CaseContext

DataClassification.description:
`CLAUDE.md`: synthetic data only, in this repo, always.

The enum has one member on purpose. Production classifications are a program concern and
adding them here would make it possible for a real-data payload to validate against a
contract in this repository.
DataClassification.title: DataClassification

DecisionDomain.description:
The distinct legal authorities this system analyses against.

ADR-003 and blueprint §2.1: suitability, fitness, PIV credentialing, and national-security
eligibility are distinct authorities with distinct criteria. Collapsing them produces
analysis that is wrong in a way that is hard to detect, so every finding names exactly one.
DecisionDomain.title: DecisionDomain

DocumentExpectation.description:
Documents the case is expected to contain.

Drives the completeness checker (blueprint §8.1). An expectation that is not satisfied
becomes an information gap, not a silent omission.
DocumentExpectation.title: DocumentExpectation

Subject.description:
The person the case concerns.

`protected_attributes_included` is a declaration, not a container. Blueprint §10.2 requires
that protected attributes not be included unless needed for a legitimate, approved purpose,
and blueprint §13.7 prohibits their use in analysis. This contract carries no field in which
a protected attribute could be placed, so the flag exists to assert their *absence* and to
let a validator fail closed if an ingestion path ever tries to introduce them.

display_name.description: Synthetic name only. See DataClassification — this repo holds no real cases.
display_name.title: Display Name

citizenship.description: Relevant to SEAD-4 Guidelines A-C analysis. Present because it is a criterion input under a named authority, not a general demographic attribute.
citizenship.title: Citizenship

protected_attributes_included.description: Structurally pinned false. If a legitimate, approved purpose ever requires protected attributes, that is a contract major version and a policy decision, not a runtime flag.
protected_attributes_included.title: Protected Attributes Included

Subject.title: Subject

description:
The case as the system is asked to analyse it.

Blueprint §10.2. Note what is absent: no aggregate risk field, no overall assessment, no
prior determination. ADR-014 forbids the first; the others would prejudice the analysis.

requested_analyses.description: A request, not an authorization. Blueprint §10.2: requested_analyses cannot override legal applicability — the authority router validates each request against case_context and may decline one or add one the requester omitted.
requested_analyses.title: Requested Analyses
